comfort
Every line and every detail seamlessly
connect in this well-crafted interior. Satin
Silver and Tortoiseshell-style accents give
the cabin a rich Sebring attitude. Limited’s
standard eight-way power driver seat
combines with standard heated leather-
trimmed front seats for optimum comfort.
Sebring Touring’s standard premium
stain-resistant(,1) antistatic seat fabric feels
custom-tailored. Rear-seat passengers
enjoy more than 36 inches of leg room.
Every trim level is equipped with fold-flat
front-passenger seatbacks and a 60/40
split-folding rear seatback that provides
complete flexibility. A single button
operates the available power sunroof.
(1)Not compatible with aftermarket fabric-protecting coatings.
